visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white long-sleeved top and a green mini-skirt, stands on a vibrant green golf course. She grips a silver golf club and putts a white ball toward a hole marked with a red flag. The setting is bright natural daylight with manicured trees and a hazy hill in the distance. Yellow bold text overlays the center of the frame. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor golf driving range. The woman, now in a bright pink polo shirt, practices her swing on a green synthetic mat. A man in a red shirt stands behind her, and rows of other practice stalls are visible under indoor lighting. She wears a white glove on her left hand. (3) Inside a fitness center labeled 'Le Green', the woman and the man perform physical exercises. They use a weighted bar for squats and a black medicine ball. A female coach in a dark blue uniform monitors their movements. The environment is a clean studio with gym equipment and wooden accents. (4) Back in the training area, the coach uses alignment sticks and a pressure mat (BODITRAK) to analyze the woman's stance. On-screen graphics display heatmaps of foot pressure. The woman follows instructions, swinging a club while a stick is positioned near her waist to guide rotation. (5) The final phase returns to the outdoor course. The woman, dressed in her original white and green outfit, attempts a putt on the green. She missteps and falls onto her knees in a playful, comedic gesture. The camera captures her reaction from a low angle against the grass.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 要怎麼從0開始學高爾夫? (2) [Subtitle]: 三個月的密集特訓 能成功下場嗎? (3) [Subtitle]: 這次肉比頭一起來挑戰! (4) [Subtitle]: 朝最終目標: 完整打短九洞 前進! (5) [Subtitle]: 第一步 『基礎課程7堂』 (6) [Subtitle]: 第1堂 還不能夠開始打! 首先要先做的是身體檢測 (7) [Subtitle]: 判斷能不能順利完成各種姿勢! 再來下一步: 基礎動作 (握桿、站姿、揮桿) (8) [Subtitle]: 初揮 烙賽 邊練習也才了解到 光是要揮到球就真的很不容易... 姿勢一個不小的誤差 球就會差超遠... (9) [Subtitle]: 第2、3堂 來練習完整的揮桿! 但沒想到幅度才比之前高半公尺而已 就讓我們吃盡了苦頭 (10) [Subtitle]: 姿勢稍微一點點的偏移 就被教練抓個正著! 或是手部的姿勢不對 膝蓋沒彎曲等等 (11) [Subtitle]: 第4、5堂 多了好多有趣的輔助工具 像這根腰上的棍子 強化放大檢視 旋轉的姿勢、位置 腰部手部動作是否到位! (12) [Subtitle]: 第6、7堂 出現了超酷的儀器! 直接檢視我們的重心轉移 因為重心其實跟你的擊球效率 有超大關係! (13) [Subtitle]: 阿翔 肉依 教練示範 (14) [Variety]: 啊 哇切到! 比肉依還爛 (15) [Subtitle]: 但其實課程還沒結束! 接下來才進到『進階課程』 (16) [Subtitle]: 進階第1堂 教練使出了高速攝影機 來分析我們的揮桿動作! 從各種角度對比 精密的矯正姿勢 (17) [Subtitle]: 進階第2堂 難道終於下場了嗎?! 其實是在旁邊的切桿區 練習『切桿』和『推桿』的技巧 (18) [Subtitle]: 用切桿在果嶺附近 把球切到果嶺範圍 再用推桿在果嶺範圍內 再把球推進洞 默默地所有的課程終於都完成啦! (19) [Subtitle]: 在經過大量的自主練習之後... 接下來就是期待已久的 短九洞大挑戰 但沒想到竟然比想像中還悲慘...qvq 記得去看完整長片...

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female host, 1 male host, 1 female coach, and 1 male coach shown during the training sessions.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main woman wears a white athletic long-sleeve top and a green pleated skirt, or a pink polo shirt and black leggings. The main man wears a red or green polo shirt with dark pants.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video alternates between a manicured outdoor golf course with green lawns and trees, an indoor driving range with multiple hitting bays and safety nets, and a professional indoor training facility with fitness equipment, data monitors, and signage for 'Le Green'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic acoustic-pop background music featuring bright guitar and a steady beat (124 BPM) starts. A friendly, high-arousal female narrator introduces the challenge. Background noise is a clean studio-grade floor. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX plays. The narrator's speech rate is fast and animated as she discusses the initial phase. A percussive 'clack'—the sound of a club hitting a ball—is clearly heard. (3) Sounds of rhythmic thudding and metal clanking occur as the scene shifts to gym exercises. The narrator uses an exaggerated, comedic tone to emphasize physical effort. (4) A digital interface 'ping' SFX is heard alongside the narrator's explanation of technology. The male character's voice shouts 'Ah!' followed by collective laughter from 2-3 people. (5) The audio environment transitions to an outdoor space, indicated by a subtle wind floor and wider acoustic resonance. The sound of golf strikes is more resonant. (6) A descending slide whistle SFX plays, marking a comedic 'fail' at the end, followed by loud, cheerful laughter as the music fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Step 1 Physical/Basic -> Step 2 Advanced Tools -> Step 3 Outdoor Practice -> Conclusion/Failure Hook.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a 3-month golf training journey for beginners, highlighting the transition from basic fitness and posture to the use of high-tech analysis tools at Le Green Golf Academy, ending with a humorous field test to encourage viewers to watch the full version.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent visual placement of 'Le Green Golf Academy' logos, filming within their branded facility, and detailed descriptions of their training services and technology.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-density social media editing with fast cuts, upbeat music, and interactive text overlays creates an engaging promotional vlog for a golf school.
